def gaptable(I,O,m):
    R,C=len(I),len(I[0])
    rows=[]
    for r in range(R):
        line=I[r]; pos=[i for i,v in enumerate(line) if v==m]
        for a,b in zip(pos,pos[1:]):
            if b-a>1:
                la=a
                while la-1>=0 and line[la-1]==m: la-=1
                rb=b
                while rb+1<C and line[rb+1]==m: rb+=1
                leftlen=a-la+1; rightlen=rb-b+1; glen=b-a-1
                filled=all(O[r][c]==2 for c in range(a+1,b))
                rows.append(('row',r,a+1,b-1,glen,leftlen,rightlen,filled))
    for c in range(C):
        col=[I[r][c] for r in range(R)]; Ocol=[O[r][c] for r in range(R)]
        pos=[i for i,v in enumerate(col) if v==m]
        for a,b in zip(pos,pos[1:]):
            if b-a>1:
                la=a
                while la-1>=0 and col[la-1]==m: la-=1
                rb=b
                while rb+1<R and col[rb+1]==m: rb+=1
                glen=b-a-1
                filled=all(Ocol[x]==2 for x in range(a+1,b))
                rows.append(('col',c,a+1,b-1,glen,a-la+1,rb-b+1,filled))
    return rows
